svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Flow arrow (1 cell) (obc-direction-line, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Box 24x48 px, anchor at (0,24). Bindable properties: _ps_medium (default 'normal'): Pipe content: normal | water | air | empty _ps_lineType (default 'fluid'): Line type: fluid | electric | air | connector _ps_fluid (default ''): Fluid colour for water/air pipes (OpenBridge palette): fresh-water | sea-water | waste | masses | fuel | oil | steam | hot | cold | air-ventilation | acid-alkalis | fire-fighting | flammable-gas | non-flammable-gas (empty = default)
